app.name: MH Policy Trainer
app.tagline: Learn the Philippine Mental Health Act and the DOH frameworks, one cited provision at a time.

documents.title: Republic Act No. 11036, the Mental Health Act
documents.blurb: The foundation. Declares mental health a basic right, lists the rights of service users, creates the Philippine Council for Mental Health and assigns duties to agencies and local governments.
documents.sourceNote: Reviewed from a legal-database copy of the law. Check quotations against the Official Gazette.

documents.title: DOH Administrative Order No. 2016-0039, Revised Operational Framework for a Comprehensive National Mental Health Program
documents.dateNote: Signed October 2016 by Health Secretary Paulyn Ubial (the scanned date line is partly illegible)
documents.blurb: The operating manual for the National Mental Health Program. Sets principles, five program components and the roles of each DOH office, PhilHealth and LGUs. Issued two years before the Act.
documents.sourceNote: Reviewed from a machine-read scan. A few characters in the scan are garbled; verify against the official DOH copy.

documents.title: DOH Administrative Order No. 2025-0028, National Policy Framework for Community-Based Mental Health Services
documents.dateNote: Signed by Health Secretary Teodoro J. Herbosa (the date line on the scan appears to read December 22, 2025; verify)
documents.blurb: The community-based framework. Sets a minimum service package, three tiers of worker competency, LGU planning duties, quarterly reporting and data privacy rules.
documents.sourceNote: Reviewed from a machine-read scan. A few words and place names are garbled; verify against the official DOH copy.

disclaimer: Educational use only. This app is not legal advice and is not an official DOH product. Always check a provision against the official text before relying on it.
crisisNote: If someone is in immediate danger, contact local emergency services. For current National Center for Mental Health crisis hotline numbers, see ncmh.gov.ph.
